title: Memory round trip across a reset

steps.post: @{agent} for future reference: our team's preferred citation style is Vancouver, and our shared drive is mapped to Q:. Please remember both.
@{agent} what citation style do we prefer, and which drive letter is the shared drive on?

groundTruth.note: The reset between the turns is an episode boundary (§3.8): turn two cannot see turn one's post, so the answer must come from memory.

pass: Turn one wrote a memory holding both facts; turn two's reply gives Vancouver and Q:.

checks.text: Turn one has a record_written event whose description would be found by a search for citation style or shared drive.
Turn two answered from its memories (the description in its prompt or a memory::read), not by guessing.
The memory holds the preference, not a transcript of the post.
